Guidelines
Millions of young people use Yubo every day to just
join in, hang out and talk. Our users are diverse and
i, so to continue
come from all around the world
building a positive and welcoming community we feel
it's important to have some rules and guidelines in
place to ensure that everyone uses the service as
safely as possible, and has a positive and respectful
experience on Yubo. We may take a number of steps,
including sending a warning, removing the content, or
blocking the accounts responsible.
We have rules that may seem stricter than other social
media apps but that's because we want to keep you
as safe as possible on the service.
Respect
Respect is very important for Yubo and will allow us to
build a great community worldwide.
• Never threaten or intimidate other users. Always be
kind and respectful.
• Don't ask for nudes or other sexual content.
• Never harass, bully or spam other users.
• Don't share content which is sexist, racist,
homophobic or discriminatory in any way.
• It's not OK to use pictures or videos of people
without seeking their permission.
